limits: GLB is checked against the shared writer; run an independent importer separately.
No vehicle-specific glass visibility, equipment support, tyre/rail or clearance proof.
No exhaustive intersections, engineering precision, appearance acceptance or device performance.
Assembly payload is a JS expansion check; independently compare a Swift formation when available.

glass_equipment.limits: Centroid rays on outward side and cab/end glass faces, and actual connected glass solid displacement; no exhaustive surface or engineering collision proof.

wheels.limits: Connected tyre solids and documented static centres only; no flanges, worn wheels, full collision, glass, equipment or dynamics proof.

lod.limits: Actual orange surface and envelope comparison; rounded window trim and small mechanical tessellation differ. Not a device LOD animation test.

doors.limits: Specified painted door faces and the known full-height false cab panel; not exhaustive visual classification or collision proof.

mouth.limits: Specified native paint boundary and two fixed static rays; photo-fitted thresholds, no complete visual acceptance, surface coverage or collision certification.

swift_assembly.arithmetic: Float32 multiplication then Float32 addition; native Z-up, yaw 0/180 degrees only; no scale.
swift_assembly.implementation: Independent Foundation-only Swift; no JS or GamePresentation imports.
swift_assembly.limits: Static configuration/native/payload verification only; does not establish real-world formation evidence, coupler compatibility, runtime selection or device validation.
swift_assembly.stored_fields: Every triangle flag and every corner Float32 XYZ / UInt32 RGBA compared byte-for-byte; derived Float32 normals and native material flags included in all-vertex FNV64.

file_protocol.reason: Browser administration blocks file:// navigation; loopback checks passed.

limits: Browser WebGL only; no device Metal, animation or appearance acceptance.
